notes: A ghost appears when a player uses the Ghost Lantern memento.
On top of the enemy ghosts (as listed in the table above), ambient ghosts can be seen flying in the air near Nighthollow Keep and in The Disquiet Study.
Prior to an early update, the three ghosts attacking you during the Wake the Dead quest were named Othrenis Ghost.

summary:
This article is about the hostile creatures. For the NPC spirits, see Spirit. Aphren's Hold, Crow's Wood, Outside the Crypt of Hearts, Crypt of the Exiles, Eidolon's Hollow, Eyebright Feld Dolmen, Fort Virak Ruins, Mal Sorra's Tomb, Othrenis, Thibaut's Cairn, Vale of the Ghost Snake, Near Valeguard Tower, Wilding Run
Direnni Acropolis Ghosts are spirits of the deceased that have been trapped on Nirn. They are often found haunting tombs and graveyards. These enemies should not be confused with spirits — ghosts all look the same (though they may vary in color), whereas spirits look like the person they were in life.
